{"id":"01a0fc4d-1331-7b01-888e-157db5f148ba","type":"decision","summary":"How invoice tax is calculated","content":"Invoice tax is calculated on the invoice subtotal, not per line: sum the line totals first (line_total), apply the customer's rate once, then round. Rates are decimal fractions (0.0825 for 8.25%) and are passed in by the caller; tax.py never looks rates up itself. Tax-exempt customers pass rate 0 and still get a tax_cents of 0 written, so reports never show NULL. The result is stored in Invoice.tax_cents and is never recomputed after finalization, even if the rate later changes. One exception, from the 2025 Revenu Quebec audit: for customers whose region is `CA-QC`, tax is computed per line (round each line's tax, then sum), because QST must be shown per line. Branch on `region == \"CA-QC\"`.","physical":["src/billing/tax.py"],"logical":["billing.tax"],"tags":["billing","tax"],"criticality":0.5,"confidence":0.8,"status":"active","visibility":"shared","provenance":"human","epistemic":"decision"}
